## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Booking
where: BookingRepository (uses), src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts, component persistence

=====SOURCE-BEGIN
private readonly bookings = new Map<string, Booking>();
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B

for (const c of this.clubBookings.findByDate(session.date)) {
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: Booking (an individual booking for a session, stored in BookingRepository as `Map<string, Booking>`) and Club Booking (stored separately and looked up by date via `this.clubBookings.findByDate(session.date)` in SessionService) are separate concepts with separate repositories. SessionService calls both BookingRepository.findBySession and ClubBookingRepository.findByDate, which suggests two kinds of reservation that both use up session capacity, not one concept under two names. Sharing the word 'booking' does not make them the same.
